description: I cannot recommend this recipe more!!! These chocolate crinkle cookies are easy, fun, and tastes just like a brownie.  Full recipe is in the link in my bio! (itschloeh.com) Let me know if you try these! #chocolatecrinklecookies #chocolatecookies #cookierecipe #easyrecipe #bakingrecipe
transcript: These chocolate crinkle cookies are one of my favorite cookies to make because they're essentially a brownie disguised as a cookie. I mean, can you think of anything better? They're super fudgy, soft, almost molten-like in the center, and covered in a funky crackly pattern. It's also the recipe that I most commonly recommend to beginner bakers because it's ridiculously easy to make while being incredibly delicious. To make these, you want to start by combining the cocoa powder and sugar, then add in all the wet ingredients including oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and coffee concentrate. Whisk it all together until you get a super glossy, shiny chocolate mixture. Now, ditch that whisk and we're going to add in all the dry ingredients, including flour, baking powder, and salt. Switch over to a spatula and fold everything together until you have a homogenous cookie dough. Then, just cover the bowl with some cling film, pop it into the fridge, and let it chill completely before moving on. Once the batter is fully chilled, it should become way less sticky and easier to work with, so scoop them into balls, shape it with your hands if you need to, then pop them into a bowl of powdered sugar. Give them a good toss so the cookie dough is fully covered, then pop it onto a baking tray and send them off to the oven to bake. If you're looking for that super molten-y and fudgy, brownie-like texture, make sure you take them out when they're slightly undercooked, then let it chill completely and enjoy these perfect little chocolate crinkle cookies. Now, I must warn you, only try this if you're ready for your mind to be blown. Grab that crinkle cookie, cut it in half, and add some vanilla ice cream to the middle. These make the most phenomenal ice cream sandwiches.
